title: Inflation on many everyday items was entirely due to tariffs, NY Fed says
summary: Recent research from the New York Federal Reserve indicates that tariffs have significantly contributed to inflation, adding 2.9 percentage points across 67 categories of consumer goods by February 2026. This finding highlights the impact of trade policies on everyday prices, suggesting that tariffs may be a critical factor in the rising cost of living. As policymakers consider future trade strategies, understanding the relationship between tariffs and inflation will be essential for economic stability.
shadowing: Tariffs have a direct effect on consumer prices.
